verdict.rationale: Figma publishes an official GitHub repository containing the OpenAPI specification and TypeScript types for its REST API, which is a downloadable machine-readable spec. The probe found nothing at the conventional developer-site paths, but that only shows the spec lives on GitHub; it does not contradict its existence. Missing for 10: a discoverable spec at a standard developer-site URL, documentation of the spec's completeness and versioning, and independent or hands-on corroboration that it works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: This repository contains the OpenAPI specification and Typescript types for the Figma REST API
